rows.coder_note: The abstract gives 542 POF cases and 218,970 controls from 'the FinnGen database' with no release number; endpoint counts with a cohort name alone do not identify a release (rule I1).

One sentence says the pQTL analysis used plasma proteomics data from 54,219 participants and baseline cohort data of 34,557 individuals of European ancestry from the UK Biobank. 34,557 European equals the UKB-PPP discovery N, but the sentence states no platform, year or citation and gives two sample sizes for the same analysis, so it does not clearly state which is the analysis dataset; exact counts with a cohort name are not enough (rule I1, N without platform or year).
